section_summary.extract_value: This section discusses limitations of 'the present study,' which appears to be a daily diary study examining relationships between self-compassion, interactions with body-focused others, and body image concerns in women. The study relied on self-report questionnaires and daily assessments, with limitations including the correlational design, inability to establish temporal relationships, brief measurement scales, and assessment at only daily (rather than intra-daily) intervals.
